Countyline Co-op is a farmer-owned cooperative providing services for grain, seed, agronomy, fuel delivery, hardware, fuel & service station, and livestock feed in northwest Ohio.
We pride ourselves on providing prompt service with personable employees who make you feel right at home.
Grain Bids:
Countyline Bids
Futures Markets
GRAIN
Countyline Co-op is a full-service grain elevator. We purchase, store, and sell wheat, corn, and soybeans. Each grain facility is equipped with knowledgeable people who are ready to assist in the smooth processing of your grain bushels.
LEARN MORE
AGRONOMY
With an office located in Pemberville, Ohio, our Agronomist can assist with all your crop planning needs. From start to finish, with Countyline Co-op you are one conversation away from a weed free and high yield field. We offer a full selection of fertilizers, chemicals, and seeds as well as custom application services, bulk delivery, and equipment rental options.
LEARN MORE
LIVESTOCK
From your farm animals to domestic pets, Countyline Co-op has a full range of supplies and feeds for all your animal needs. Do you take your animals to the fair? Countyline provides show feeds from ADM, Kalmbach, Purina and more! We also offer custom blends through our feed mill for cattle, pigs, chickens and goats.
LEARN MORE
STORE
Countyline Co-op’s hardware store is your one stop shop for any project around your farm and home. Carrying a vast variety of products including farm supplies, gardening, Sullivan show merchandise, pest control, paint supplies, oils, plumbing, electrical, tools, nuts & bolts and a great selection of Red Wing boots.
LEARN MORE
FUEL/CAR CARE
Countyline Car Care is a full-service station for all your vehicle’s fuel, maintenance, and repair needs. As a Napa AutoCare Center, we pride ourselves in using reliable products while servicing your vehicle and maintaining competitive rates for our customers.
LEARN MORE
